name: Cubic Gallery
description: Full-screen 3D tunnel of four photo walls that fill in tile by tile around a centered title. Clicking a tile unfolds it to full screen, and a Focus button fades the walls in.
contents: Four perspective walls (top, right, bottom, left) of image tiles
Centered blurred hero block with title, subtitle and Focus button
Back button shown while a tile is open
behavior: Images are preloaded then assigned to random empty tiles at a set interval
Hovering a loaded tile shows an outline
Clicking a tile unfolds its wall to fill the viewport and pauses filling
Back button closes the open tile and resumes filling
Focus button animates the wall edge fade in and out
editableByProps: Images, grid density, fill speed, wall depth, perspective and tile gap
Background, accent and tile outline colors
Hero title, subtitle and button labels, or hide the hero block

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how deep each wall tile starts before it flies in
Change the unfold animation of an opened tile
Remove the superscript mark after the title
needsCodeEdit.where: h2 element with the accentColor span

fixed: Root fills the viewport height (h-screen) and clips overflow; override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto
Loads the Mona Sans font through an @import in the style block
Tiles are built as DOM nodes imperatively, so changing images or density rebuilds the walls
Opened tile uses 100vw by 100vh, so the component is intended to span the full viewport
